cases.name: optimistic-delete-rollback
cases.prompt: In our React + TanStack Query app, the design for the Saved Reports list says: 'Deleting a report should feel instant.' Each row has a Delete button that calls DELETE /api/reports/:id. Deleted reports cannot be recovered server-side. Implement the Delete behaviour for the row component and the list.
cases.trap: Without the skill, a model typically removes the row optimistically and shows a 'Deleted' toast immediately, with no rollback on failure, no duplicate-click guard, and focus dropped to <body> when the row disappears; it also ignores that the action is irreversible.
expectations: Handles request failure by restoring the row (or never removing it) and showing an error that says what failed and how to retry
Prevents duplicate delete requests while one is pending for the same row
Addresses the irreversibility, e.g. a confirmation step, an undo window before the request is sent, or waiting for server confirmation before claiming success
Moves keyboard focus to a sensible remaining element (next row, previous row, or list heading) after the row is removed
negative_expectations: Shows a success message before the server has confirmed deletion while providing no rollback path
Leaves focus on a removed element or lets it fall to the document body

cases.name: hover-revealed-row-actions
cases.prompt: The design for our file browser table says: 'Row actions (Rename, Share, Delete) appear on the right when the user hovers a row; otherwise they are hidden to keep the table clean.' Implement this with React and CSS modules.
cases.trap: The literal implementation uses only :hover with display:none or visibility:hidden, making the actions unreachable for keyboard users and invisible on touch devices.
expectations: Reveals the actions when focus is inside the row (e.g. :focus-within) so keyboard users can reach and see them
Provides a touch/no-hover fallback, e.g. actions visible by default under @media (hover: none), or an always-visible overflow menu
Gives the action buttons accessible names that identify the row's file (or otherwise distinguishable labels)
negative_expectations: Actions are revealed only by :hover with no keyboard or touch path
Hides actions with display:none in a way that removes them from the tab order with no alternative
